title: JM Die Milling Tool Library — Fusion 360 Importable Export
brief: Walks mcp-server/src/data/*-tools-extracted.json + *-tools.json (the brand catalogs JM Die uses in practice), filters to MILLING tool types, and emits a Fusion 360 .tools importable library. Closes user directive 'extract all milling tools from jm tool libraries for fusion'.

close_out_log.note: scripts/extract-jm-milling-tools-fusion.mjs — pure Node script. Walks 30 brand catalogs in mcp-server/src/data/ (Accupro / AMPC / Camfix / Emuge / Flash / Guhring / Helical / ISCAR / Mitsubishi / OSG / SECO / Sandvik / Walter / YG-1 / etc.), filters for MILLING tool types (endmill / ballmill / facemill / chamfermill / bullnose / slotmill / threadmill / formmill / tapered — excludes drill / tap / bore / ream / countersink / spotting), maps each tool record to the Fusion 360 .tools schema (BMC + description + product-id + type + unit + vendor + post-process + geometry{DC/DCN/NOF/OAL/LF/SFDM/+RE for bull-nose} + holder + start-values), and emits state/shared/jm-fusion-tools/jm-milling-tools.{json,tools,md}. First run: 41137 tools scanned, 19370 milling tools extracted. By brand: ISCAR 5449 / OSG 3598 / unknown 3376 / YG-1 2517 / Sandvik 1286 / Accupro 1224 / Seco 1224 / Guhring 688 / Emuge 8. Operator: drag jm-milling-tools.tools into Fusion 360 Manage tab -> Tool Library -> Import.

units.title: extract-jm-milling-tools-fusion.mjs + Fusion .tools output + operator MD index
exit_conditions: Filters to milling tool types (excludes drill/tap/bore/ream/etc.)
Maps PRISM canonical tool record to Fusion 360 .tools schema
Emits jm-milling-tools.json (intermediate manifest with by-brand counts)
units.description: Operator can now build a Fusion 360 program against the same tool inventory JM Die uses in practice — no manual re-entry of 19K tools. Compounds: every chat re-running the script picks up new brand catalogs as they're extracted.

acceptance: scripts/extract-jm-milling-tools-fusion.mjs runs to completion. state/shared/jm-fusion-tools/jm-milling-tools.tools is a Fusion 360 importable library with 19370 milling tools across 8 named brands. Operator drags into Fusion -> Manage -> Tool Library -> Import.

risks.description: 3376 tools have manufacturer='unknown' — they survived the filter on type alone. Mitigation: filter by manufacturer:!=unknown in MS1 once provenance is added to source catalogs.

Fusion 360 .tools schema is reconstructed from public examples — Fusion may reject a tool entry whose holder block is incomplete. Mitigation: ship default ER32 holder for every tool (engine-side fallback).
